title: Router UI {application_version}
subtitle: Manifest-driven package installation checkpoint
fixture_banner: NON-PRODUCTION FIXTURE — NOT FOR ROUTER INSTALLATION
summary: Three hardware-independent Router UI packages are installed on an existing supported OpenWrt system. No firmware image, bootloader, partition layout, or hardware qualification is implied.
healthy_adopted: The complete adopted panel is enabled only when the adopted overlay is healthy and mutation status is clear.
fail_closed: Adoption-required, drift/recovery, reboot-pending, and read-only states keep persistent VPN mutations blocked. Read-only diagnostics remain separate.
steps: Verify the signed manifest and every package fact.
Record platform, services, routes, storage, and a private off-router backup.
Use wired local management and validate the manifest-derived storage gates.
Install the exact three-package set transactionally; never mix candidate bytes.
Reboot, verify identity and service/route invariants, then restore the fixture.
Adopt a manual Xray configuration only through a fresh hash-bound preview.
stops: Signature, manifest, package hash, package size, version, target, or storage mismatch.
Recent out-of-memory kills, reboot loop, management-path loss, or daemon instability.
Unknown Xray path, unsupported layout, drift, recovery lock, or pending reboot validation.
